extracted text: The study investigates a high Zn-containing Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloy extruded plate. The plate was obtained by hot extrusion on a perfectly homogenized ingot with a diameter of 220 mm and a length of 1400 mm. The specimens were solution heat treated at 465°C for 1.5h followed by cold water quenching, then subjected to different aging treatments. The T6 treatment was 120°C for 24h. The T79, T74, and T73 treatments all started with 110°C for 8h and then had different times at 160°C: 3h for T79, 10h for T74, and 16h for T73.
